headline: Highest risk is medium: Chatwoot’s broad egress and customer data can feed Perplexity’s vendor-hosted browsing, creating leakage and downstream misuse pathways; no direct shared-write conflict is evident.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: A plausible injection path exists if Chatwoot content is manually copied into Perplexity or if Perplexity outputs are pasted back into Chatwoot workflows. Chatwoot has broad network egress and customer-facing message content; Perplexity is a browser-based answer engine. No shared filesystem or MCP bridge is documented, so this stays low.
conditions: IF operators copy Chatwoot conversation text into Perplexity prompts
IF Perplexity-generated text is pasted into Chatwoot replies without review
mitigations: Use a copy/paste policy that strips instructions from customer text
Add a short human review step before sending Perplexity output to customers
Keep Chatwoot and Perplexity in separate browser profiles
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to copied snippets

B_data_leakage.rationale: Chatwoot touches customer data, contact profiles, interaction history, and orders; Perplexity uploads documents and sends queries to vendor-hosted search/backends. Even without a shared filesystem, moving Chatwoot content into Perplexity can expose sensitive customer data to a third party in default use. The pair therefore has a default leakage pathway.
conditions: IF customer records or interaction history are pasted or uploaded into Perplexity
IF Perplexity search prompts include identifiers from Chatwoot tickets
mitigations: Redact names, emails, order IDs, and message bodies before use
Restrict Perplexity to non-sensitive summaries
Disable uploading Chatwoot exports to Perplexity
Train operators to use synthetic examples for troubleshooting
requires-engineering: route sensitive cases to an internal-only tool

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Chatwoot can integrate with external services and has broad egress, while Perplexity is vendor-hosted and cannot write the host filesystem or modify git state. There is no documented shared mutable resource or overlapping write surface, so direct capability conflict is limited to coordination mistakes rather than destructive contention.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same external SaaS account or API token
IF operators treat Perplexity output as a write instruction for Chatwoot-integrated systems
mitigations: Assign separate credentials per tool
Avoid concurrent edits to the same external record
Use a single operator for write actions
Document which system is source of truth

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity is explicitly a citation-producing answer engine, so Chatwoot content can become input to its summaries, and those summaries may be reused in support replies. Because Chatwoot handles customer-facing messages, an error in Perplexity can cascade into incorrect support actions unless a human verifies the output.
conditions: IF Chatwoot agents rely on Perplexity summaries as authoritative
IF Perplexity output is forwarded into customer replies or internal decisions without verification
mitigations: Require human verification before sending any Perplexity-derived answer
Ask Perplexity for sources and cross-check them
Limit Perplexity to research, not final responses
Flag unsupported claims in Chatwoot macros
requires-engineering: add a verification checklist in the workflow

E_compliance.rationale: Chatwoot processes customer data and interaction history, while Perplexity is vendor-hosted with browsing and uploaded-document analysis. If regulated customer data or EU PII is moved from Chatwoot into Perplexity, residency and retention obligations may diverge. The profiles do not prove a specific regime mismatch, so medium is the cautious choice.
conditions: IF Chatwoot tickets contain regulated personal data
IF those records are entered into Perplexity for analysis
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Perplexity prompts
Use anonymized excerpts only
Check vendor privacy terms before sharing customer data
Set a retention rule for copied notes
requires-engineering: route regulated cases to a compliant internal system
